summary: Radnostix Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing its acquisition of certain assets related to the Lara System technology platform and Ellexa Explorer Software from Lucerno Dynamics, LLC. The initial purchase price was $900,000, comprising $150,000 cash and $750,000 in common stock valued via 20-day VWAP. Potential milestone payments include up to $500,000 in stock for regulatory approval and $250,000 in stock for sales milestones, plus cash earn-outs. The board recommends the transaction. No advisor named. The deal closed on the effective date. Watch for milestone achievements and integration risk; the small size limits arbitrage interest.
